summary: Executed public API and browser regression testing for overview, field-report rerouting, state filtering, Assamese toggle, dashboard load, console errors, and mobile overflow.

minor.issue: Reports increase the selected route risk/incidents and reroute vehicles, but are not appended to the overview incidents collection; the dashboard alert list therefore remains static after submission.

action_items: Append submitted field reports to the in-memory incidents feed (or expose a refreshed alert source) so the new incident appears in dashboard alerts after submit.
Remove any duplicate BACKEND_URL declaration if it reappears; supervisor logs contained a transient duplicate-constant compile error, though the current build loaded successfully.
critical_code_review_comments: The report endpoint mutates global in-memory fixtures and does not persist the report incident in incidents, causing overview and alert data to diverge from the route risk state.
The frontend displays hard-coded alert count and alert rows, so backend risk spikes cannot fully drive the visible alert experience.
seed_data_creation: Created one TEST-prefixed Assam report through the API test and one browser report; both mutate the demo's in-memory state.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Overview contract and report risk/reroute behavior passed. Desktop and mobile UI flows passed with no browser console errors. Retest alert-feed synchronization after report persistence is fixed.
rca of the issue: POST /api/reports updates target route and vehicle dictionaries only. It never appends a new incident to incidents, while the React alert panel is hard-coded rather than derived from data.incidents; therefore the report toast works but the live alert list/count cannot reflect the submitted event.
